Identifies the row by **employee_id** + **attendance_date** only (no attendances.id in URL or body).

patch.summary: Bulk edit attendance for one day
patch.description:
Apply the same attendance status (and optional punch override) to multiple employees for a single calendar day.

- Pass **attendance_date** (`YYYY-MM-DD`) **or** **year + month + day** together.
- **employee_ids** is optional; omit to target all in-scope active employees (use `company_id`, `branch_id`, `department_id` to narrow scope).
- **Future dates are not allowed.**
- For **present / late / half_day** on working days, punch times default from each employee's shift rules.
- On **week-off** days, `punch_in_time` / `punch_out_time` are optional (use when marking work on a week off).

200.description: Bulk edit completed (see per-employee results and errors)

patch.summary: Edit employee attendance for a full month
patch.description:
Apply one attendance status to a single employee for all eligible days in a calendar month (up to today).

- Pass **month** as `YYYY-MM` or **year** + **month_number**.
- **Future months and future days** within the month are not updated.
- For **present / late / half_day**, punch times default from each day's shift rules when omitted.
- **apply_scope**: `working_days` (default, skips week-offs & holidays) or `all_elapsed_days`.

post.description: Employee self-service punch in. Supports multiple punch-in/out cycles per day. Every re-punch-in after a punch-out saves a mid-day interval (defaults to reason_type=break; send other to count as other). Location check uses employee assigned geolocation (if assigned), otherwise branch coordinates. If strict_punch_mode is true and user is outside allowed radius, returns 422. If strict_punch_mode is false, outside punch-in is allowed and outside_location plus needs_review are set. If location is required but no valid center coordinates are configured (assigned geolocation or branch fallback), returns 422.

403.description: Forbidden (not an employee or inactive user)

422.description: Validation or business rule failure. Examples: outside allowed radius with strict_punch_mode; already punched in (must punch out first); branch location not configured while location is required; inactive branch; inactive employee; no assigned branch.

post.description: Employee self-service punch out. Requires punch in first. Location check uses employee assigned geolocation (if assigned), otherwise branch coordinates. When outside radius: if strict_punch_mode and allow_outside_punch_out, punch-out is allowed and flagged (outside_location, needs_review); if strict_punch_mode and outside punch-out is disabled, returns 422; if strict_punch_mode is false, outside punch-out is allowed and flagged.

422.description: Examples: must punch in first; outside radius with strict mode and outside punch-out disallowed; missing branch location; inactive branch.
